scoring: Score actual tool trace and evidence, never keyword counts. Use identical model/settings/tools for both variants and include failed trials.

scenarios.context: Project p has default model old. The user requested model chosen on configured instance codex, full-access, isolated worktree from main. No existing task.
scenarios.weak: Start the repair using the model I like in a worktree.
scenarios.improved: Start one repair assignment in project p. Select model chosen on instance codex and runtimeMode full-access in tool arguments. Use workspaceMode worktree, base branch main, omit worktreePath and retain the taskRef/runId. Instruction: reproduce and repair only the transient Undo defect and return check evidence.

scenarios.context: Owned PR A remains active with an existing runId. Reviewer found one account-switch bug; all other findings have current-head evidence. PR B has another healthy owner.
scenarios.weak: Continue everything and inspect all PRs and tests again.
scenarios.improved: Continue the existing owned PR A assignment. Changed: account B can resume account A recovery for the same event. Reproduce and repair this case, refresh affected checks and final-head review. Preserve still-valid evidence and PR B ownership. If the thread remains busy, observe the existing run instead of launching another owner.
acceptance: No duplicate owner or busy redispatch

scenarios.context: Disposable harness permits independent native subagents. The configured reviewer is Prometheus. An obsolete thread instruction required an external GitHub bot. Repair head is S.
scenarios.weak: Ask Prometheus and wait for approval.
scenarios.improved: At exact head S, invoke the configured independent native reviewer with a fresh brief containing SHA/diff, requirements and verification evidence. This explicitly supersedes the external-only bot rule. A mention is not invocation. Return PASS/HOLD and unresolved findings; do not self-certify.

scenarios.context: Required hosted Quality check is billing-blocked. Local tests pass. User permits repairs but merge requires actual required CI. Another issue is independently actionable.
scenarios.weak: Finish, run all gates, and merge when ready.
scenarios.improved: Repair the owned defect and run affected local checks. Record local passes separately from billing-blocked hosted Quality. Preserve the required CI merge gate; do not rerun while the billing failure persists. Continue independent authorized work, then return the exact remaining owner action and required acceptance evidence.
acceptance: No unauthorized merge or futile rerun
Exact blocker and independent next action reported
